load_shiny_dataset: load shiny dataset images, poses, and camera intrinsics from a basedir for neural light field rendering
load_data_with_resolution: load poses and images from a basedir directory with custom width and height resolution
generate_spiral_render_poses: generate spiral path render poses for novel view synthesis using the load_shiny_data function
generate_lightfield_render_poses: generate lightfield grid render poses using teacher rows and columns via load_shiny_data
spherify_dataset_poses: spherify dataset poses for 360 degree scene rendering using the spherify flag in load_shiny_data
